one_line: It gives a player a persistent profile layer for OOC identity — a country flag next to chat derived from their IP plus database-stored metacoins (Doubloons) and a purchased/cosmetic inventory.
player_facing_mechanics: An OOC country flag is shown for a player, derived from their IP's geolocation (with Scotland/Wales/Quebec region special-casing on top of country code).
The flag appears in chat via a spritesheet icon tag, falling back to a 'flag-unknown' icon when the country has no asset.
A persistent metacoins ('Doubloons') balance is loaded per player from the database and shown in chat as deposits/withdrawals.
Doubloon changes can be announced with a reason (e.g. 'Doubloons deposited to your account! Reason: ...').
A per-shift earning cap (max_round_coins) limits how many Doubloons can be gained, with a 'Doubloon limit for this shift' message when hit.
A player can possess an inventory of purchased cosmetic items, loaded from a metacoin_item_purchases table.
Store cart / loadout items are tracked per player, with special handling categories 'unusual', 'single-use', and 'generic'.
data_only_parts: /datum/preferences var storecart_list (assoc list of typepaths to item info)
DB schema/table/column references: metacoin_item_purchases(item_id, amount), player(metacoins, ckey)
logic_parts: /proc/ip2country — HTTP geolocation lookup and country_flag assignment with region special-casing
/proc/country2chat_flag — resolves a country to a chat spritesheet flag icon tag with unknown fallback
/datum/preferences/proc/load_inventory — builds inventory from DB purchase rows via text2path
/datum/preferences/proc/load_metacoins — reads metacoins from the player table (defaults to 100 when DB unavailable/mockclient)
/datum/preferences/proc/adjust_metacoins — round-cap enforcement, DB UPDATE, economy logging, and chat announcement
byond_specific: world.Export("http://ip-api.com/json/[ipaddr]") to reach an external HTTP server
json_decode / html_decode / file2text on the returned CONTENT file handle
addtimer(CALLBACK(GLOBAL_PROC, GLOBAL_PROC_REF(ip2country), ...), 60 SECONDS) retry on rate-limit
SSdbcore.NewQuery / warn_execute / NextRow / item DB-call API
port_notes: The prefs/currency/inventory half maps cleanly to SS14 as a player-preference component plus a persisted (DB or server-storage) bank/inventory system, with an economy log category and a chat-visible balance event; the per-shift cap is a ruleset/round-scoped variable that could be a game-rule or round-state field. The country-flag half must be re-implemented: world.Export becomes a RobustToolbox HttpClient call to a Geo-IP service, and the chat flag becomes an overlay/chat-markup entry rather than a BYOND spritesheet icon_tag. SS14 currently has no first-class preferences subsystem, so a human must decide the persistence schema, DB access layer, and how flags are rendered in the chat UI. Design questions: anti-spoofing/accuracy and rate-limit handling for IP geolocation, privacy/consent for storing country data, and whether Doubloons belong in SS14's planned economy or a bespoke table.
